specialist-gloves-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Forest DDPAT
specialist-gloves-forest-ddpat.desc:
Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. The hand stitched leather has been paired with rugged DDPAT printed fabric.

Some people don't like getting their hands dirty

ak-47-redline.name: AK-47 | Redline
ak-47-redline.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic and a dry-transfer decal of a red pinstripe.

Never be afraid to push it to the limit

ak-47-frontside-misty.name: AK-47 | Frontside Misty
ak-47-frontside-misty.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been painted in vibrant arctic colors.

I like to work in the snow... it always leaves a pretty picture - Javier Alviso, Fist of the Phoenix

ak-47-neon-rider.name: AK-47 | Neon Rider
ak-47-neon-rider.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A deadly biker can be seen in the foreground of various neon, blended patterns.

Two parts Trapper Keeper, three parts synthesizer

aug-lil-pig.name: AUG | Lil' Pig
aug-lil-pig.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. This custom paint job features a red base and metallic gold accents. A red pig has been added near the butt stock.

At home on the range

awp-the-end.name: AWP | The End
awp-the-end.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted using eggplant and white colors with flames, roses, and "the end" in front of the trigger.

A tale of two sides

bayonet-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Bayonet | Doppler
bayonet-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

pp-bizon-seabird.name: PP-Bizon | Seabird
pp-bizon-seabird.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in an aqua and tan color scheme.

Mine.

pp-bizon-forest-leaves.name: PP-Bizon | Forest Leaves
pp-bizon-forest-leaves.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been spray-painted using leaves as stencils.

pp-bizon-irradiated-alert.name: PP-Bizon | Irradiated Alert
pp-bizon-irradiated-alert.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been spray-painted with radiological warning hazard patterns.

dual-berettas-flora-carnivora.name: Dual Berettas | Flora Carnivora
dual-berettas-flora-carnivora.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. Three brightly colored, hungry carnivorous plants have been custom painted on each Dual Beretta.

Help them grow up big and strong

galil-ar-metallic-squeezer.name: Galil AR | Metallic Squeezer
galil-ar-metallic-squeezer.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. Metallic paint pen graffiti has been applied over a flat black base.

"It's art, I shouldn’t have to explain it"

glock-18-weasel.name: Glock-18 | Weasel
glock-18-weasel.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been given a hydrographic of Bobby the Mischievous Weasel.  Don't mess with Bobby.

Just because he's cute, doesn't mean he doesn't bite

glock-18-sacrifice.name: Glock-18 | Sacrifice
glock-18-sacrifice.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. This custom paint job pays homage to olofmeister's burning defuse on Overpass at ESL One Cologne 2014.

"The defuse is coming in—he's still going!"

glock-18-synth-leaf.name: Glock-18 | Synth Leaf
glock-18-synth-leaf.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A teal and purple hydrographic pattern of overlapping leaves has been applied.

Blood on the leaves

p2000-pulse.name: P2000 | Pulse
p2000-pulse.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted with a hydrographic of bold fuchsia fragments.

Striking colors for a striking weapon

p2000-royal-baroque.name: P2000 | Royal Baroque
p2000-royal-baroque.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. A blue and gold filigree pattern has been applied.

"I'm not kitting around..."

butterfly-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Tiger Tooth
butterfly-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

butterfly-knife-stained.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Stained
butterfly-knife-stained.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

butterfly-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Urban Masked
butterfly-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

falchion-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Boreal Forest
falchion-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

flip-knife-autotronic.name: ★ Flip Knife | Autotronic
flip-knife-autotronic.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

gut-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Gut Knife | Doppler
gut-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

kukri-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Boreal Forest
kukri-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

shadow-daggers-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Doppler
shadow-daggers-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Boreal Forest
stiletto-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

bowie-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Doppler
bowie-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Gamma Doppler
bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

ursus-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Doppler
ursus-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m4a4-eye-of-horus.name: M4A4 | Eye of Horus
m4a4-eye-of-horus.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a white base, gold accents, and the Egyptian falcon god Horus.

Rise above the rest

m4a4-desert-storm.name: M4A4 | Desert Storm
m4a4-desert-storm.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been painted using a desert camouflage hydrographic.

m4a1-s-briefing.name: M4A1-S | Briefing
m4a1-s-briefing.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been given a hydrographic of a topographical map.

Everybody has a plan…

m4a1-s-decimator.name: M4A1-S | Decimator
m4a1-s-decimator.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with totally radical blue and pink highlights.

Quiet retrofuturism

m4a1-s-control-panel.name: M4A1-S | Control Panel
m4a1-s-control-panel.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been hand painted with colorful dials and switches atop a blue base.

"Is this line secure?"

m4a1-s-fatal-glitch.name: M4A1-S | Fatal Glitch
m4a1-s-fatal-glitch.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted using bright green pearlescent paint.

When keeping a low profile isn't an option

m4a4-tornado.name: M4A4 | Tornado
m4a4-tornado.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a tornado color scheme.

Don't be fooled by its simplicity

mac-10-sienna-damask.name: MAC-10 | Sienna Damask
mac-10-sienna-damask.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A damask flower pattern has been spray-painted atop the weapon's tan-colored base.

Technically the best camouflages are the ones you don't notice...

mac-10-palm.name: MAC-10 | Palm
mac-10-palm.desc: Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been spray-painted using cardboard cutouts, fine mesh, and palm leaves as stencils.

mag-7-heat.name: MAG-7 | Heat
mag-7-heat.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted to look as though it just came out of the forge.

Make some outlines of your own

mp7-astrolabe.name: MP7 | Astrolabe
mp7-astrolabe.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. A metallic design has been applied over a dark-colored base.

"IT'S NOT A CIRCUIT BOARD!"

mp9-featherweight.name: MP9 | Featherweight
mp9-featherweight.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted in black and white to appear porous, which saves weight for the weapon holder.

A good marksman doesn't blame their tools

negev-drop-me.name: Negev | Drop Me
negev-drop-me.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. A stop sign has been custom painted near the assault grip over a mostly brown base.

If the stop sign doesn't convince you the stream of bullets will

negev-dazzle.name: Negev | Dazzle
negev-dazzle.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been covered in blue and white zebra stripe decals.

Finally, a gun for trivia lovers

negev-palm.name: Negev | Palm
negev-palm.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. This memento from Gwalior been spray-painted using cardboard cutouts, fine mesh, and palm leaves as stencils.

Beautiful today...ashes tomorrow

nova-walnut.name: Nova | Walnut
nova-walnut.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has a figured walnut stock.

nova-mandrel.name: Nova | Mandrel
nova-mandrel.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. A grayscale hydrographic pattern of interweaving pipes has been applied.

Shaping rounds with each shot

nova-predator.name: Nova | Predator
nova-predator.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been spray-painted in a zebra stripe pattern.

p250-cassette.name: P250 | Cassette
p250-cassette.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A custom paint job inspired by video cassette packaging from the 1990s has been applied.

Check the tape

p250-cyber-shell.name: P250 | Cyber Shell
p250-cyber-shell.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with a silver slide and hexagon-textured grip.

You represent the front line of our cyber security effort

p90-mustard-gas.name: P90 | Mustard Gas
p90-mustard-gas.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A blue-green base coat has been finished with a yellow hydrographic "ground smoke" pattern.

Denying information is as important as obtaining it

sawed-off-limelight.name: Sawed-Off | Limelight
sawed-off-limelight.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted with swooping curves in lime green and white.

All eyes on you

sawed-off-bamboo-shadow.name: Sawed-Off | Bamboo Shadow
sawed-off-bamboo-shadow.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been painted with a hydrographic of brush-painted bamboo.

Kotaro lost his son to this gun... and one day he'll use it to stop the man responsible

scar-20-trail-blazer.name: SCAR-20 | Trail Blazer
scar-20-trail-blazer.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been custom painted with a monochrome black design and silver inlays.

FOR USE BY AUTHORIZED CT AGENTS ONLY

sg-553-damascus-steel.name: SG 553 | Damascus Steel
sg-553-damascus-steel.desc: The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has some damascus steel parts.

ssg-08-dragonfire.name: SSG 08 | Dragonfire
ssg-08-dragonfire.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been given a hydrographic of a monstrous dragon snorting fire.

Sit on your horde and wait for any who come to take it

ssg-08-grey-smoke.name: SSG 08 | Grey Smoke
ssg-08-grey-smoke.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A grayscale graphic pattern has been applied.

"Do you know how much color cartridges cost?!"

ssg-08-lichen-dashed.name: SSG 08 | Lichen Dashed
ssg-08-lichen-dashed.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils.

tec-9-brass.name: Tec-9 | Brass
tec-9-brass.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. Parts of the weapon have been replaced with brass.

Fool's gold

ump-45-arctic-wolf.name: UMP-45 | Arctic Wolf
ump-45-arctic-wolf.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A custom paint job has been applied which resembles the white coat of an arctic wolf.

Every round is a 1v5

ump-45-crime-scene.name: UMP-45 | Crime Scene
ump-45-crime-scene.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been custom painted with yellow caution tape over a red and blue base.

Clear the area, we've got work to do…

ump-45-gold-bismuth.name: UMP-45 | Gold Bismuth
ump-45-gold-bismuth.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A gold bismuth pattern has been sandwiched between white and black base coats.

"You have expensive taste…"

usp-s-royal-guard.name: USP-S | Royal Guard
usp-s-royal-guard.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with a solid blue slide and finished with gold accents.

It is rare that beauty is so obvious

usp-s-pathfinder.name: USP-S | Pathfinder
usp-s-pathfinder.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been spray-painted with a stencil of an isometric labyrinth.

Personally I prefer the 4th edition, but the customer is always right - Booth, Arms Dealer

xm1014-zombie-offensive.name: XM1014 | Zombie Offensive
xm1014-zombie-offensive.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A custom pattern of zombified Counter-Strike agents has been applied.

"Undead game"

xm1014-halftone-shift.name: XM1014 | Halftone Shift
xm1014-halftone-shift.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been custom painted using a multicolored halftone design.

"It's from a zoo, but instead of animals on display it's art"

xm1014-xooom.name: XM1014 | XoooM
xm1014-xooom.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A yellow pattern has been applied and finished with silver accents.

ZZZZZAP!
